svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 07 · Riverside · 04/12 Box Springs (Uncommon)
svg.desc: Brown boulder hills right behind campus. Take water, go early, and watch the town come up. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
